topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Finding the hidden room in this house has stirred up a whirlwind of thoughts I didn’t expect. I knew there were secrets hidden in these old walls, but I didn’t anticipate uncovering them so directly. The room is small, concealed behind a false wall in the attic—a space untouched, as if trapped in time. I can’t help but wonder what was so important to keep concealed. Part of me wishes I hadn’t found it, that I could avoid the questions and the responsibility that come with such a discovery. Yet, here I am, staring at the past, feeling the weight of what I’ve stumbled upon, and wondering how to move forward without disrupting the delicate balance of this new life I’ve just begun to build.
